title: ScaleSense: Cost-Intelligent Scaling Framework via Learned Resource Estimation in Alibaba AnalyticDB
abstract: arXiv:2608.07945v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cloud-native serverless data warehouses achieve fine-grained elasticity by decoupling storage from compute, yet determining the optimal resource allocation for highly heterogeneous ad-hoc queries remains a formidable industrial challenge. Our analysis of production workloads in Alibaba AnalyticDB exposes a costly ``provisioning trap'': the fear of catastrophic resource depletion drives users to blindly over-provision resources, wasting immense monetary budgets without alleviating non-CPU bottlenecks (e.g., I/O saturation). To break this impasse, we propose ScaleSense, a proactive, query-level resource scaling framework. Specifically, it features a multi-faceted query encoder that jointly models plan topologies and hardware specifications. translated_title: ScaleSense：通过阿里云AnalyticDB中的学习型资源估计实现成本智能伸缩框架
translated_abstract: 云原生无服务器数据仓库通过将存储与计算分离实现了细粒度的弹性，但为高度异构的临时查询确定最优资源分配仍然是一个艰巨的工业挑战。我们对阿里云AnalyticDB生产工作负载的分析揭示了一个代价高昂的“配置陷阱”：对灾难性资源耗尽的恐惧导致用户盲目过度配置资源，浪费大量资金预算却未能缓解非CPU瓶颈（如I/O饱和）。为打破这一僵局，我们提出了ScaleSense，一种主动的、查询级别的资源伸缩框架。具体而言，它采用了一个多方面的查询编码器，联合建模计划拓扑和硬件规格。关键在于，一个基于分位数的资源预测器估计多维物理足迹，作为最优资源伸缩的可靠安全网。随后，一个自动伸缩控制器实现……
tldr: ScaleSense提出了一种基于学习型资源估计的查询级主动伸缩框架，通过分位数预测器避免过度配置，从而在阿里云AnalyticDB中实现成本高效的资源分配。
en_tdlr: ScaleSense proposes a proactive query-level scaling framework with learned resource estimation using quantile-based predictors to avoid over-provisioning, enabling cost-efficient resource allocation in Alibaba AnalyticDB.
